title: Which country drinks the most alcohol per adult?
subtitle: Pick the country whose adults drink the most from four suspects, then see how France, Russia, Uganda and the world average compare.
form: choose on the figure (tap a drawn flag)
notes: Two figures in turn: four flags for the choice, then the bar chart (Saudi Arabia 0 to Romania 17, litres per adult 15+, 2020 = latest on OWID). Bar chart flags and tick labels stay small (template).
